## Frequently Asked Questions

###

Salesforce is the [#1 AI CRM](https://wp.salesforce.com/crm/worlds-number-one-crm/) (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic AI](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/what-is-agentic-ai/) and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is](https://www.salesforce.com/products/what-is-salesforce/) and [what Salesforce does](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/) by visiting [our official resources](https://wp.salesforce.com/company/our-story/). Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform.

###

[**CRM**](http://salesforce.com/crm/what-is-crm/) stands for **customer relationship management.** It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you:

- **Organize** contact information, leads, and customer service data
- **Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails
- **Analyze** data to understand customer behavior and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you a** single**, [**360-degree view of every customer**](https://www.salesforce.com/products/what-is-customer-360/), allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale.

###

[**Agentic AI**](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/what-is-agentic-ai/) refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act [**autonomously**](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/autonomous-agents/) to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional [AI](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/what-is-ai/) that only generates content or analyzes data, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) technology — is used to:

- **Automate** complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
- **Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
- **Personalize** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

###

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from [startups and small businesses](https://www.salesforce.com//small-business/) to large global enterprises. Our Salesforce Platform is **flexible** and **scalable**, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an [AI and CRM](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/ai-crm/) platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.
